title: AI Prompt Guard engine configuration (apg_create)
description: UTF-8 JSON passed to apg_create(). Unknown keys are rejected with APG_ERR_CONFIG: a misspelt limit or policy can never silently become a default.

manifest_path.description: Path of dist/<os>/<arch>/<ruleset_version>/manifest.json, or of the dist/<os>/<arch>/active.json pointer written by 'rules.py activate --pointer-dir'. A path that does not exist -> APG_ERR_CONFIG.

verify_ruleset.description: false (default): the rule set is loaded as it is; no hash / version / platform bookkeeping of the manifest is checked, and Hyperscan itself refuses a database it cannot use (other Hyperscan version, missing CPU features). true: full verification of the manifest (SHA-256 of every file, build_hash, ABI and normalisation-table versions, OS / arch, Hyperscan version string, CPU features). `ai-prompt-guard verify` and the rule compiler self-test always run with true.

max_text_bytes.description: Largest text (primary or any named field). Larger -> status=error, error_code=input_too_large.

max_request_bytes.description: Largest request JSON for apg_scan_json (APG_ERR_LIMIT). Must be >= max_text_bytes.

max_hits.description: Candidate matches per view scan before the scan is aborted (error_code=hit_limit_exceeded).

scratch_pool_max.description: Idle scratch spaces kept for reuse (a scratch space is never shared by two scans).

verify_budget_ms.description: Wall-clock budget per request after which PCRE2 confirmation of prefilter candidates is skipped (reported as a warning; policy.on_verify_error decides).

allow_block.description: false (default): the engine only answers allow / review / alert (alert-only). true: scores >= thresholds.block yield 'block'.

on_error.description: Decision when a text cannot be scanned (invalid UTF-8, too large, hit limit). 'block' requires allow_block=true. There is no silent allow unless you configure it.

on_verify_error.description: A PCRE2 limit was hit (or time ran out) while confirming a Hyperscan prefilter candidate: 'review' raises an otherwise 'allow' decision to 'review'.

needs_context_review_at.description: Overrides scoring.needs_context_review_at of the rule set (default 0.50): rules that matched but could not be evaluated completely (missing context / field) raise an 'allow' to 'review' when their risk reaches this value. 1.0 effectively disables the escalation; the findings stay visible in needs_context[].

thresholds.description: Override the thresholds stored in the rule set (review 0.30, alert 0.50, block 0.85 by default).

include_offsets.description: Add evidence[] (byte offsets) to every matched rule.

include_names.description: Add the rule name to every matched rule.

include_evidence_text.description: Add the matched fragment of the original text, its normalised form and its sentence to every evidence[] entry (needs include_offsets). Set false when the result must not contain any text of the request.

pcre2.description: Hard limits of the PCRE2 confirmation step (catastrophic backtracking protection).
